items.summaryEn: A vast number of developers at Refractor Games, the development team responsible for Fifa World Cup: Launch Edition, have been laid off. In total, roughly 85 percent of developers at the studio have lost their jobs. Read more

items.titleRu: Lighthouse, порт игры Banjo Kazooie для ПК Harbour Masters, уже доступен
items.titleEn: Lighthouse, the Harbour Masters PC port of Banjo Kazooie is out now
items.summaryRu: Хотя у нас уже был один порт Banjo Kazooie для ПК с Banjo: Recompiled, теперь у нас есть еще один порт от команды Harbour Masters. Прочтите полную статью о GamingOnLinux.
items.summaryEn: While we already had one PC port of Banjo Kazooie with Banjo: Recompiled, we now have another from the Harbour Masters crew. Read the full article on GamingOnLinux .
